function_args: grid_id text, grid_element_id text, include_self boolean DEFAULT true
description: Returns list of grid_elements on the path(s) that receive power flowing from the highest source (primary producer element) through the specified grid_element. The specified grid_element is included in the list if include_self = true.

function_args: valid_at timestamp with time zone, grid_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, extra_columns boolean DEFAULT false, active_only boolean DEFAULT false
description: Returns the list of grid_elements that were valid at the specified valid_at time. Grid elements are valid from the valid_at time provided at ingestion, until they are changed or removed from the grid in a subsequent ingestion. If a grid_id is specified, only elements from this grid will be returned. By default, only NULL values are returned for the `switch_is_open`, `power_flow_direction`, and `upstream_grid_element_id` columns for optimal performance. If these values are desired, ensure that `extra_columns` is true. Note that grids start as active, but can be de-activated/re-activated; if `active_only` is true, only those grids that are still currently active will be returned.

function_args: grid_id text, grid_element_id text, max_depth integer, terminal integer DEFAULT 0
description: Returns list of grid_elements on the path(s) from the given grid element to other elements that are near. The maximum number of connections to check can be specified through the max_depth parameter. If terminal is 1 the function will compute paths from terminal 1 that do not go through terminal 2. Conversely if terminal is 2. If terminal is 0 both sets of paths will be computed.

description: Returns list of grid_elements on the path(s) from the given grid element to elements that are producers (is_producer = true). If highest_source = true, pathing will only be to the primary producer element.
